subject: Cross type for Brem et al. dataset?

messages.author: 336302ea68c5f13f
messages.subject: Cross type for Brem et al. dataset?
parts:
I am trying to analyze data generated in the paper:

The landscape of genetic complexity across 5,700 gene expression
traits in yeast
Rachel B. Brem*,† and Leonid Kruglyak*,‡

Here they simply crossed two haploid yeast lines and genotyped the F1
generation.
Which cross type should I use? Are there special steps needed to
analyze a haploid species?

Thanks for all the great work!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Cross type for Brem et al. dataset?
parts:
I think you can treat them as a backcross.

karl
